statement: The hydrostatic-column benchmark reports verdict 'fail' with 4 of 8 criteria false. Its 2.75 % bottom-pressure error exists only for the best run (Adami wall, c0 = 20): c0 = 10 gives -4.30 %, c0 = 5 gives -8.74 %, the Tait-only wall model gives -25.23 %, and the per-layer core maximum relative error is 43.17 %. The 2.7 % figure is therefore a single bottom-load number and must not be read as per-layer pressure accuracy.

scope.domain: SPH hydrostatic pressure / wall boundary condition
scope.system: 3-D wall-bounded column at rest, 8x8 base, nz in {12,16,24}, rho0 = 1000 kg/m^3, g = 9.81 m/s^2
exclusions: does not cover dynamic free-surface cases

notes: The failed criteria are interior_pressure_within_15pct_best, bottom_pressure_within_15pct_all, column_settled_window_drift_below_2pct and centre_of_mass_drift_below_1pct.
Re-derived reference: p_bottom = rho0*g*(H - dx/2) = 1000*9.81*0.155 = 1520.55 Pa.
